description: Timetable fetch performance measurements; no timetable payloads, credentials, cookies, URLs or flow keys retained.

experiments.method: Sequential canonical GitHub flake runs after help warmup; registration reads only. Stdout stays in memory and is compared in full without retaining timetable contents. Stage times are nested and must not be added wholesale. headersMs combines resolution, TCP/TLS, request transmission and waiting for response headers. outsideProfileMs also includes process/CLI startup and exit, not solely Nix.
